Customer.title: Customer Profile
Customer.description: Represents a registered customer's public profile and contact details.

displayName.description: Full display name of the customer.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 server timestamp of profile creation.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 server timestamp of last update.

Product.title: Artisan Product
Product.description: Heirloom product bases, custom sizes, and items available for etching or customization.

name.description: Name of the artisan item (e.g., Live-Edge Walnut Board).

description.description: In-depth description of dimensions, materials, and oil finishes.

imageUrls.description: List of high-resolution asset paths for visual carousel showcases.

inStock.description: Availability status of raw timber or blanks in the Portland workshop.

featured.description: Whether the product is highlighted in the primary website carousel showcase.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when catalog entry was created.

Review.title: Bespoke Patron Review
Review.description: Verified patron feedback and rating systems, subject to admin moderation.

customerUid.description: UID of the registered customer author.

customerName.description: Name displayed publicly with the review.

approved.description: Moderation status; only approved reviews are displayed publicly.

Announcement.title: Workshop Announcement
Announcement.description: Marketing promotions, workshop events, and holiday order cut-off notices.

title.description: Title of the announcement bar or header banner.

description.description: Content of the announcement alert message.

imageUrl.description: Optional illustration or promotional badge URL.

eventDate.description: Optional scheduled calendar date associated with the event.

expirationDate.description: The date after which this alert is hidden.

active.description: Toggle switch to manually enable or disable the banner.

QuoteRequest.title: Bespoke Engraving Quote Request
QuoteRequest.description: Custom orders submitted by clients, including dimensions, engravings, and uploaded mockups.

customerUid.description: Optional registered user UID (supports anonymous & signed-in users).

productId.description: Target base product ID selected from catalog.

productName.description: Target product name (snapshot at time of quote).

customizationDetails.description: Detailed engraving requests, monogram text, preferred fonts, and sizing.

inspirationUrls.description: List of uploaded image URLs (references in Cloud Storage).

status.description: Current workflow state of the bespoke project.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when status or notes were last modified.

Admin.title: Admin Role Definition
Admin.description: Stores security clearances and roles for business operations.

/customers/{customerUid}.description: User profiles for private/public dashboard settings.

/products/{productId}.description: Artisan custom decor and premium wood/leather/glass catalog items.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Customer feedback and star ratings displayed on showcase sections.

/announcements/{announcementId}.description: Active banner alerts, promotion alerts, and timeline updates.

/quoteRequests/{quoteRequestId}.description: Client quote inquiries, monogram details, files, and workshop status indicators.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Restricted document storage containing admin verification records.
